NutriBiotic Fresh Fruit NonSoap Skin Cleanser is a moisturizing, vegan formula specifically designed for individuals with normal to dry skin. Apply to skin for gentle cleansing. Rinse thoroughly.

Water (aqua); sodium C14-16 olefin sulfonate; cocamidopropyl betaine, disodium oleamido sulfosuccinate, vegetable glycerin, extracts of symphytum officinale (comfrey) leaf, chamomilla recutita (matricaria), calendula officinalis, cucumis sativus (cucumber) fruit, and equisetum arvense (horsetail); sodium PCA; panthenol; allantoin; citrus paradisi (grapefruit) seed extract [citricidal]; citric acid; sodium chloride, sodium benzoate, potassium sorbate, and fragrance.
Made without sodium lauryl/laureth sulfates, cocamide DEA, free chlorine derivatives, colorings, fragrance, gluten, phosphates, paraben preservatives, and phthalates.

For external use only. Use only as directed.

Hello! We're Seven Minerals
9 years ago, we set out as a family to make products we were proud of. Products with clean, good-for-you ingredients that would be safe for us, and more importantly our children. 
Since then, our family and business have grown, but our purpose has remained the same. We're still proud to use our products, and hope you will be too! 
Suggested use
Everyday tips for using your nourishing Castor Oil: 
Use the oil to massage your entire body including head, hands & feet. 
Massage the oil into your scalp. Leave overnight. 
Apply the oil to your feet. Wear a pair of socks and leave overnight. 
Apply the oil to your face. Then lay a warm, wet towel over your face for greater moisturizing. 
Apply the oil to your eyelashes once a week. Leave it overnight.
Apply the oil to your lips at night for moisture.
Massage the oil into dry cuticles to have well-manicured nails. 
Rub a small amount into eyebrows before you go to sleep. 
Apply the oil in your beard every night.
Other ingredients
Organic ricinus communis (castor) oil. 
Warnings
Store in a cool, dark place. 
Test a tiny amount on your inner arm 24 hours before applying it to your face. For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. If irritation, redness or discomfort occurs, discontinue use.

heart disease
high blood pressure
thyroid disease
diabetes
trouble urinating due to an enlarged prostate gland
persistent or chronic cough such as occurs with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis or emphysema
cough that occurs with too much phlegm (mucus)

nervousness, dizziness, or sleeplessness occur
symptoms do not get better within 7 days or occur with fever
cough lasts more than 7 days, comes back, or occurs with fever, rash or headache that lasts. These could be signs of a serious condition.

Store at 20-25°C (68-77°F).

Plastic Bank Certified
OEKO Tex Certified
Wave Goodbye To Plastic 
Every year, over 8 million tons of plastic waste end up in our oceans, harming marine life and ecosystems. 
Our Mission 
At Fomin, we're passionate about protecting our oceans and your skin. By avoiding single-use plastics where we can and embracing low-water technology in all our products, we're on a mission to create a cleaner planet.
Clean For You & Our Planet 
Refreshing, gentle and highly effective. Fomin Deodorant Wipes swipe on easily with no sticky residue for long lasting freshness. Formulated with naturally derived Mandelic Acid (found in bitter almonds), our wipes gently exfoliate and acidify your skin to combat odor causing bacteria while visibly brightening your skin and eliminating ingrowns.
Powered by Nature
Mandelic acid gently acidifies skin to combat odor causing bacteria
Aloe vera soothes and calms irritation for lasting comfort
Niacinamide boosts hydration by strengthening the skin barrier
Suggested use
When you need it most
Gym
Desk
Purse
Car
Other ingredients
Aqua, glycerin, aha (mandelic acid), gluconolactone, niacinamide, peg-7 glyceryl cocoate, lavender extract, lavandula angustifolia (lavender) oil, chamomilla recutita oil, aloe barbadensis extract, chamomilla recutita flower extract, vitamin e, melaleuca alternifolia (tea tree) leaf oil, fragrance (limonene, linalool, citral, geraniol, linalyl acetate).
Warnings
For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not apply to broken or irritated skin. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Do not flush. Please dispose responsibly. 
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep sachets sealed until use.
